# Section 040: Continuous Delivery With Flux

Flux is the second GitOps controller the exam allows. This compact section teaches the Flux objects that match the Argo CD skills the reader already has, so they can pick either tool on exam day. It comes after Argo CD because it reuses the same repositories and packaging and only changes the controller.

**Curriculum item covered:** Implementing GitOps Workflows for Application and Infrastructure Deployment

---

## What You Will Master

- Install the Flux controllers and check them with flux check
- Create a GitRepository source and a Flux Kustomization that applies a path with prune enabled
- Read the Ready condition of sources and Kustomizations with flux get and kubectl describe
- Force a reconcile and suspend and resume a Kustomization
- Order two Kustomizations with dependsOn
- Create an OCIRepository or HelmRepository source and a HelmRelease with inline values
- Read HelmRelease status and history and find why an install or upgrade failed
- Configure install and upgrade remediation so a failed upgrade rolls back
- Load values from a ConfigMap with valuesFrom
- Match each Flux object to the Argo CD object that does the same job
